content.title: Manchester City vs Liverpool 4-0: FA Cup quarterfinal – as it happened
content.text: 4 Apr 2026 - 14:03 (14:03 GMT)That’s a wrap!Our coverage of Manchester City vs Liverpool in the FA Cup quarterfinals has ended.City ran out comfortable 4-0 winners on their home turf, sailing into the semifinals for the eighth successive time, as they bid for their eighth FA Cup.Liverpool, on the other hand, suffered yet another crushing defeat in their dismal campaign.Thank you for joining us this afternoon, and we will be back with more live sporting action very shortly as Atletico Madrid face Barcelona in La Liga for our featured game later on Saturday.Goodbye!4 Apr 2026 - 13:59 (13:59 GMT)Missed the match? Read our comprehensive reportErling Haaland has hit a hat-trick as Manchester City thrashed Liverpool 4-0 to reach the FA Cup semifinals and increase the pressure on Reds boss Arne Slot.Haaland netted twice late in the first half of the quarterfinal at the Etihad Stadium and completed his treble after the interval following an Antoine Semenyo strike.With Liverpool trailing by four, Mohamed Salah had a penalty saved by City goalkeeper James Trafford to compound a miserable afternoon for the under-fire Slot.Liverpool’s tame surrender was a bitter blow to Slot, who had to endure chants of “you’re getting sacked in the morning” from gloating City fans.Read more here.4 Apr 2026 - 13:54 (13:54 GMT)A hat-trick was a long time coming, Haaland saysHaaland’s hat-trick today was his 12th with the club.Asked about how he felt after walking away with another match ball, Haaland said: “Of course, it had been some time since I had done it [scoring a hat-trick] with City, so it was about time I did it again.“Another hat-trick is always nice and special. I am super happy.”Speaking about his performance this season, the 25-year-old added: “It’s been too much up and down, which is not good enough, and I cannot keep thinking about what I could’ve done differently or what happened or didn’t. … I have to think about the next game.“The reality is it’s a long week for us as we aren’t in the Champions League, which isn’t good enough. But we won today, and now we have to start focusing on Chelsea because it’s a massive game again.”4 Apr 2026 - 13:49 (13:49 GMT)‘Another Wembley trip is amazing’: Hat-trick hero Haaland“Honestly, in the first half, we struggled a bit, but after 30 minutes, we kept going, and in the end, it was an amazing game at home,” Haaland told broadcaster TNT Sport.“Another Wembley trip for us, it’s amazing and important.”Asked if it was City’s best performance this season, he replied: “I think so. Between 30 and 60 minutes, it was one of the better ones.”4 Apr 2026 - 13:44 (13:44 GMT)Recap: Haaland bags hat-trick as Man City hammer Liverpool 4-0Haaland scored ⁠a ⁠hat-trick as Manchester City crushed Liverpool 4-0 in their FA Cup ⁠quarterfinal at the Etihad Stadium to cruise into ⁠the last four.Haaland fired the opener from the penalty spot in the 39th minute after O’Reilly ‌was fouled, and the Norwegian doubled his tally in first-half stoppage time with a well-placed header from an excellent cross by Semenyo.Semenyo got on the ⁠scoresheet himself five minutes ⁠after the break, and Haaland completed his treble with a shot off the underside ⁠of the crossbar in the 57th minute ⁠before Liverpool’s woes continued ⁠when Salah had a penalty saved.In the other quarterfinals, Chelsea take on Port ‌Vale and Southampton host Arsenal later on Saturday with Leeds United ‌travelling ‌to West Ham United on Sunday.4 Apr 2026 - 13:41 (13:41 GMT)What’s next for both teams?After crashing out of the FA Cup in the quarterfinals, Liverpool shift their focus to the Champions League. They are due to travel to Paris to face PSG in the first leg of their quarterfinal meeting on Wednesday.As for Man City, they travel to London to play Chelsea in next Sunday’s Premier League fixture.4 Apr 2026 - 13:35 (13:35 GMT)Full-time: Manchester City 4-0 LiverpoolManchester City thrash Liverpool 4-0 in the standout tie of the FA Cup quarterfinals!A hat-trick from Haaland and another goal by Semenyo guided City to an utterly dominant win over the Reds.They’re off to the semifinals for an eighth successive time!For Liverpool, it’s another disappointing result in a rather dull season as they crash out of another competition. The visitors had a promising start but failed to convert their chances with Salah missing a penalty in the second half.Haaland of Manchester City celebrates scoring his hat-trick [Carl Recine/Getty Images]4 Apr 2026 - 13:32 (13:32 GMT)Konate, Gonzalez go into the referee’s bookKonate drags an onrushing Savinho to pick up a yellow card.A minute later, Gonzalez faces a similar fate for a foul on Szboszlai.We’re now in the final minutes of this quarterfinal, which City have dominated from the get-go.87 mins: Manchester City 4-0 LiverpoolGet instant alerts and updates based on your interests. Be the first to know when big stories happen.4 Apr 2026 - 13:29 (13:29 GMT)A look at Haaland’s attacking numbers Erling Haaland has now scored 46 goals in 50 games for club and country this season. 🤖 His game by numbers vs. Liverpool: 76 minutes played6/8 accurate passes3 duels won3 touches in opp. box3/3 shots on target3 goals His 28th career hat-trick. 🎩 pic.twitter.com/YTi5m2MvyK — Squawka (@Squawka) April 4, 202683 mins: Manchester City 4-0 Liverpool4 Apr 2026 - 13:27 (13:27 GMT)Who will Man City face in the semifinal?City will have to wait until the final quarterfinal ends on Sunday to find out their opponent.The draw for the semifinal will be held 15 minutes after the match ends.82 mins: Manchester City 4-0 Liverpool
